items.quote: Volunteering here changed how I see my own city. In six months our team reached four villages, and the foundation made every rupee and every hour visible to us.
items.name: Priya Raghavan

items.quote: My daughter went back to school because of their education support. Today she says she wants to be a doctor. I have no words, only gratitude.
items.name: Selvi Murugan

items.quote: I give monthly and I get a proper receipt and an impact report every quarter. That transparency is exactly why I keep giving.
items.name: Arun Prakash

items.quote: We ran our CSR health programme with I&H across twelve villages. Clean reporting, solid execution on the ground, no surprises.
items.name: Meera Iyer

items.quote: After the floods their team reached us before anyone else. Food, medicine, and people who stayed to help us rebuild.
items.name: Karthik Doss
